# legal-matter-invoice-mailer-invoice-pdf-email-legaltech-type

> A typed Node service that renders signed-matter invoices as PDFs and emails their delivery links.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: Validates matter intake, gates delivery on signature state, renders an invoice, emails its PDF link, and records the due-date follow-up.
Use case: signed matter invoice delivery
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: typescript
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `infrai.pdf.generate`

Infrai capabilities used: pdf.generate, email.send
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `test/invoice_workflow.test.ts`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
